column7: A v0.96.x replica running during a rolling upgrade cannot replace the v2 audit retention anchor with the v1 layout (which drops the cumulative purged count for good): on PostgreSQL a BEFORE UPDATE trigger refuses that write, so the older binary purge rolls back whole. The schema epoch floor 3 stops older binaries from starting afterwards. Not covered: a DELETE followed by INSERT of the anchor row bypasses a BEFORE UPDATE trigger.
